svg.title: OP-05 — KALEDO: Where campus skills meet industry demand.

g.text: Where campus skills meet industry demand.
An academia × industry portal for students, recruiters and institutions.
Supabase auth with RLS-enforced roles, OTP institution verification,
and a skill-match engine that ranks internships by weighted fit.
Supabase auth · RLS-enforced roles · Google OAuth
OTP institution verification via Edge Functions
